metadata.title: Add cache auth/crypto key material and derived objects
metadata.author: shoummu1

description:
## :rocket: Performance Improvement PR

### :pushpin: Summary
Cache JWT keys, derived AESGCM objects, SSL contexts and signature validation to reduce per-request CPU and I/O overhead:
- Cache JWT public/private key contents with mtime tracking and `@lru_cache`
- Cache derived AES key bytes and `AESGCM` instances; invalidate when `AUTH_ENCRYPTION_SECRET` changes
- Add SSL context caching keyed by CA certificate hash in `resource_service`, `tool_service`, and `gateway_service`
- Add `clear_ssl_context_cache()` helpers and call them from autouse test fixtures for isolation
- Cache Ed25519 public key loads and validation results; add `clear_signature_caches()`

### :link: Related Issue
Closes: #1831

### :chart_with_upwards_trend: Root Cause
- Auth and crypto helpers re-read or re-derived secrets and keys on every call (file I/O + repeated crypto allocations)
- `get_key()` re-hashed passphrase and recreated `AESGCM` on each encode/decode
- JWT verification/creation read key files per request
- SSL contexts were created repeatedly for the same CA certificates
- Signature validation re-parsed public keys and re-verified identical payloads repeatedly

### :wrench: Solution
- JWT: `_read_key_file_cached()` uses file `mtime` and caches contents; `get_jwt_public_key_or_secret()` / `get_jwt_private_key_or_secret()` are `@lru_cache(maxsize=1)`
- AESGCM: `_crypto_cache` maps passphrase → `(key_bytes, AESGCM)` and is cleared when passphrase rotates; `get_key()` and `_get_aesgcm()` reuse cached objects
- SSL contexts: module-level `_ssl_context_cache: dict[str, ssl.SSLContext]` keyed by SHA-256(cert_pem); `_get_cached_ssl_context()` returns cached `SSLContext` and limits cache size
- Gateway: added `_get_cached_ssl_context()` + `clear_ssl_context_cache()` and updated `create_ssl_context()` to reuse cache (previously missing)
- Tests: added `clear_ssl_context_cache()` calls in autouse fixtures for `test_gateway_service.py`, `test_resource_service.py`, and `test_tool_service.py` to guarantee test isolation
- Signature validation: cache loaded public keys and validation results; provide `clear_signature_caches()` for tests
- Benchmarks: extended scripts to include gateway SSL caching benchmark; added warm-up and cached vs uncached timings

### :test_tube: Verification
| Test | Command | Status |
|------|---------|--------|
| Unit tests (212 tests) | `pytest tests/unit/mcpgateway/utils/test_jwt_config_helper.py tests/unit/mcpgateway/utils/test_services_auth.py tests/unit/mcpgateway/utils/test_validate_signature.py tests/unit/mcpgateway/services/test_resource_service.py tests/unit/mcpgateway/services/test_tool_service.py -v` | :white_check_mark: 212/212 pass |
| Cache-clear fixtures | Unit test coverage | :white_check_mark: pass |
| Module imports | All cache clearing functions | :white_check_mark: pass |

### :bar_chart: Performance Results
**Benchmark Testing:**

| Component | Uncached (per-op) | Cached (per-op) | Speedup | Improvement |
|-----------|------------------:|---------------:|--------:|------------:|
| **JWT key read** | 0.5394ms | 0.0003ms | **1972.8x** | 99.9% |
| **Ed25519 signature validate** | 0.4010ms | 0.0089ms | **45.2x** | 97.8% |
| **AESGCM encode** | 0.0606ms | 0.0271ms | **2.24x** | 55.3% |
| **SSL context (gateway_service)** | 0.8071ms | 0.5080ms | **1.59x** | 37.1% |
| **SSL context (resource_service)** | 0.9935ms | 0.8033ms | **1.24x** | 19.1% |
| **SSL context (tool_service)** | 0.6847ms | 0.6120ms | **1.12x** | 10.6% |

### :trophy: Key Improvements
- **JWT key caching:** Eliminates file I/O on every auth request - nearly 2000x speedup
- **Signature validation:** 45x faster by caching validation results - massive savings on repeated verifications
- **SSL context caching:** 1.12-1.59x faster across all services; gateway_service improvements were largest (this was the missing piece)
- **AESGCM reuse:** 2.24x faster by reducing object allocation overhead
